call_points.text: Capex of ₹80-120 Cr a year planned for sustenance and growth.
Nuclear order book is ₹1,235 Cr, including GHAVP 1 and 2, Kaiga 5 and 6, and Kudankulam safety package.
A nuclear tender for about eight reactors is expected in the next few months.
Solar order book is 5-7% versus a 10-12% target, held back by the delayed KUSUM 2.0 scheme.
Valves margin fell to single digits on lower exports, product mix and commodity prices; management sees it as temporary.
S/4HANA cost allocation will hit OpEx next year; amount not yet decided.
Exports have not recovered yet; inventory built for export orders is still partly held.

operating_notes.text: Order wins in Q4FY26 included a gas separation unit for a Kazakhstan petrochemical project, NTPC's Nabinagar and Gadarwara 800 MW plants and an IOCL Gujarat project, with no values disclosed.
11 pumps were dispatched for the Kudankulam nuclear project in Q4FY26.
The Sinnar plant test lab received NABL and BIS accreditation.
Nuclear order book of ₹1,235 Cr includes GHAVP 1 and 2, Kaiga 5 and 6, and Kudankulam safety package; deliveries run about 48 months from order.
Shirwal plant capacity is 1,200-1,300 pumps a year across energy, oil & gas and nuclear, running at 80-90% utilisation before the new shed.
Solar H1 revenue was ₹50-60 Cr, with solar at 5-7% of order book against a 10-12% target due to KUSUM 2.0 delay.
Received ₹85 Cr order from ONGC for replacement of 7 main injection pumps, executable by FY 2029.

timeline.summary: Canadian Kay Pump Limited, promoter of KSB Limited, holds 70,554,240 equity shares as of March 31, 2026, with no encumbrances declared.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹601.3 Cr (+1.0% YoY), net profit ₹39.8 Cr (-22.9% YoY).
KSB Limited accepted Price Waterhouse LLP's resignation and recommended B S R & Co. LLP as statutory auditor on April 30, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): sales ₹601.3 Cr; press release lists unvalued order wins from Kazakhstan; NTPC and IOCL.
On May 20, 2026, KSB Limited held its 66th Annual General Meeting to consider financial statements, dividends, and auditor appointments.
Ksb Limited’s 66th AGM on May 20, 2026, voted on resolutions via remote e-voting (May 17–19) and in-person electronic voting, with results submitted by Ashwini Inamdar, Scrutinizer.
On 19 August 2026 KSB's institutional investor meet disclosed H1 CY2026 revenue of ₹1,292 Cr, orders on hand of ₹2,744.5 Cr including ₹1,235 Cr nuclear, and a double-digit full-year growth target.
On October 16, 2026, KSB Limited announced a ₹85 Cr order from ONGC for the replacement of 7 main injection pumps to be executed by FY 2029.
